beforeWriteLog.text: if @@admin <> 1 if not exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = @controller and exists(select 1 from sysrightmenu b where b.user_id = @@userId and a.id = b.menu_id and a_view = 1)) begin select '$NotAuthorize' as message return end

getDynamicReportTemplate.text: select rtrim(user_id) + '_' + rtrim(id) as id, report_name%l as text, 'rdlc' as fileType, 'false' as disabled, '' as image, id as xid, user_id, '1' as dynamic from sysreportprint where (user_id in (@@userId, 0) or form_type = 1) and controller = '@@controller' order by case when user_id = @@userId then 0 else id end
